post.description: Validate natural-language or structured App Spec input and return a bounded ApplicationProfile. Natural-language analysis selects an LLM by policy, retries invalid output, and labels bounded local-rule fallback; structured input is converted without an LLM. This endpoint does not recommend infrastructure, select an Agent, create a manifest, submit a deployment, or process runtime feedback.

post.summary: Prepare AI-App requests for an approved initial revision
post.description: Project an approved initial single-node, single-replica revision to inference and app request bodies for POST /aiapp/deployments. The selected resource_id must be nsId/infraId/nodeId. The approved application name and version must match AI-App catalog identifiers. The caller supplies model and artifact IDs and can pin the initial vLLM scheduler limit. Verify the catalog and node and bind the application environment before submission. This operation only prepares request bodies.

correlation_id.description: Must equal resource_recommendation.request_id. The full decoded request is immutable for this ID; use a new ID if any field changes.

runtime_id.description: AI-App runtime pinned by the approved plan.

accelerator.description: When required is false, type must be empty or omitted and count_min and memory_mib_min_per_device must be zero or omitted.

deployment-agent.ResourceOpsRecommendati.description: Resource Ops owns ranking. Deployment Agent checks each ranked node's total and available CPU, memory, required storage, and required GPU count, type, health, and memory before accepting it as feasible. Insufficient or missing capacity remains rejection evidence in the Flow; selection uses the first feasible nodes in the original order. Duplicate resource IDs and nonsequential ranks are invalid input.

available_cores.description: Omission or insufficient availability makes the resource infeasible.

available_mib.description: Omission or insufficient availability makes the resource infeasible.

memory_available_mib.description: Required for a matching device to count as available.

max_num_seqs.description: Initial vLLM scheduler limit to include in the prepared inference arguments.

deployment-agent.AIAppPlacementReview.description: Selected CB-Tumblebug node group's review summary. AI-App compares the IDs with the existing node.

requested_operation_agent.description: Operation Optimization Agent requested for the joined deployment status and Feedback.

manifest_revisions.description: Ordered guarded manifest revisions in this Flow.

scaling_decision_history.description: Newest Guard-approved KEEP, SCALE_OUT, and SCALE_IN recommendations retained in this in-memory Flow. Older entries are evicted and counted in scaling_decision_history_dropped. This is not a durable action or research outcome journal; deleting the Flow or restarting loses it.

scaling_decision_history_dropped.description: Number of older approved decision records evicted from this Flow.

deployment-agent.ScalingDecisionRecord.description: Immutable-in-Flow snapshot of one approved local scaling recommendation. Upstream occurred_at and updated_at values are sender-declared; the accepted_at and committed_at values are KHU service local timestamps. No field confirms command acceptance, replica readiness, or user SLO effect.

decision_id.description: Stable local ID derived from correlation_id and feedback message_id; not an action ID.

application_context_accepted_at.description: Local time this application context was accepted by KHU.

resource_recommendation_accepted_at.description: Local time this recommendation was accepted by KHU.

input_manifest_request_message_id.description: Common JSON message ID named by deployment status causation_id.

deployment_status_accepted_at.description: Local time this status message was accepted by KHU.

optimization_feedback_accepted_at.description: Local time this feedback message was accepted by KHU.

committed_at.description: Local time KHU committed the Guard-approved decision.

output_manifest_revision.description: Present for SCALE_OUT or SCALE_IN when an optimized revision was generated.

output_manifest_request_id.description: Local request ID of that optimized revision; not an execution acknowledgement.

output_manifest_request_message_id.description: Common JSON message ID of that optimized revision; not an execution acknowledgement.

decision_id.description: Local decision identity assigned after Guard approval. This is not an execution action ID and is absent from rejected proposals.

action.description: Canonical scaling recommendation. KEEP preserves the latest guarded plan's desired replica count. Legacy NO_ACTION is accepted only as an Operation Agent proposal/result value and is normalized to KEEP before Guard validation; new responses use KEEP.

current_replicas.description: Latest guarded plan's desired count; an applied replica count is not independently observed here.

deployment-agent.OperationOptimizationRe.description: Evidence returned by the Operation Optimization Agent after deployment status and optimization Feedback are joined. run_id is a deterministic, auditable operation execution identifier derived from the Flow and Feedback event. A completed result carries source, request_guard, result_guard, scaling_guard, and decision; all Guards remain outside the Agent. Terminal failed or rejected evidence may omit unavailable identity, Guard, latency, and decision fields and contains only terminal-safe evidence. Only a completed result with approved Guards can populate scaling_decision.

agent_name.description: Present when the selected Agent identity is known.

latency_ms.description: Present when execution latency is available.

trigger_decision_id.description: Local scaling decision ID for an optimized revision; absent from the initial revision. It is not an execution action ID.

agent_name.description: Selected configuration or Runtime Agent name

auth_token_env.description: Environment variable name containing an optional bearer token. The token value is never returned.
Optional environment variable name containing a bearer token.
